import json
s=json.load(open('/workspace/validation/openapi.json'))
for n in ['ProjectServerUpdateRequest','ServerOperationRequest','EvalRunCreateRequest']:
print(n,json.dumps(s['components']['schemas'].get(n)))
for p in ['/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/validate','/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/tools','/projects/{project
Id}/servers/{serverId}/tools/call']:
print(p,json.dumps(s['paths'][p]['post'].get('requestBody')))

ut a `suiteId` or a `suiteName` \u2014 are rejected with `VALIDATION_ERROR`.\n\n`environmentId` requires `suiteId`: an environment
